title: Hanford's public WTP record progresses from about 50,000 to more than 100,000 gallons
summary: Washington Ecology reported about 50,000 gallons vitrified as of February 2026, and DOE later reported more than 100,000 gallons since hot commissioning began in October 2025. Denominator: Two cumulative Low-Activity Waste Facility snapshots with different publication authorities and approximate thresholds: about 50,000 gallons by February and more than 100,000 gallons by May 2026.
